raw:
The paper proposes a knowledge-graph path retrieval and re-ranking framework. It then uses generative AI to turn the selected paths into explanations, so the generator is conditioned on retrieved paths. This fits the definition of RAG, since knowledge-graph retrieval counts as long as retrieved text reaches the generator. The abstract reports experiments, ablations and baseline comparisons. It never labels the method as RAG, but it positions itself against RAG methods. That leaves some uncertainty, but the design looks like graph-based RAG, so I lean toward including it.
